svg.title: From a normal representation to a finite matrix corner
svg.desc: A faithful normal unital representation of a nonzero finite factor with normalized faithful normal trace is embedded by dominated positive forms, one for each cyclic summand. The multiplicity space is indexed by an arbitrary set J times the natural numbers. Its commutant is the corner p of the opposite matrix algebra. The canonical diagonal trace is finite on p exactly when p is finite. Infinite trace would produce a countable shift inside p. A matrix corner of rank n greater than the trace of p contains an equivalent projection q. For the hyperfinite factor, its opposite algebra and all nonzero finite amplified corners are isomorphic to R.
svg.metadata: Original reproducible SVG, CC0 to the extent of rights held. Exact proofs: normal-representations-and-finite-trace-corners.html#na0 through #na6, equations NA0–NA20. Human methods: Anantharaman and Popa, author draft, printed123–127, https://idpoisson.fr/anantharaman/publications/IIun.pdf; Peterson, author notes2020, Proposition6.4.12, p107, https://math.vanderbilt.edu/peters10/teaching/spring2020/OperatorAlgebras.pdf. Every source retains its own rights.
